map.最小样本量估算 使用指南: Minimum sample size estimation user guide
map.基于 Cochran 公式计算调查所需最小样本量，支持有限总体修正（FPC），并: Compute the minimum sample size for a survey based on the Cochran formula, with finite population correction (FPC), and compare sample size needs at different confidence levels.
map.做问卷/投放 A/B 前先算需要多少样本才 statistically 可靠。: Before surveys / A/B tests, compute how many samples are needed for statistical reliability.
map.已知置信水平与误差限度，反推最小样本量避免浪费。: Given confidence level and error limit, back-calculate the minimum sample size to avoid waste.
map.比例未知时取 p=0.5 得最保守（最大）样本量。: When the proportion is unknown, take p=0.5 for the most conservative (largest) sample size.
map.：n=(z²·p·(1−p))/e²，z=1.96、p=0.5、e=0.05 →: : n=(z^2 x p x (1-p))/e^2, z=1.96, p=0.5, e=0.05 -> n=1.96^2 x 0.25/0.0025 approx 384.16, take 385. This is the most conservative sample size.
map.：同样 p=0.5、e=5%：90% 置信 z=1.645 → n≈267；95: : same p=0.5, e=5%: 90% confidence z=1.645 -> n approx 267; 95% -> 385; 99% z=2.576 -> 663. Higher confidence or smaller error needs more samples.
map.p(1−p) 在 p=0.5 时最大，算出的样本量最保守，确保即使真实比例未知也: p(1-p) is maximal at p=0.5, giving the most conservative sample size, ensuring sufficiency even when the true proportion is unknown.
map.误差限度 e 怎么定？: How to set the error limit e?
map.按决策精度需求，市场调研常用 ±3%–5%；误差减半样本量翻 4 倍，需权衡成本: By decision-precision need, market research commonly uses +/-3%-5%; halving error quadruples sample size, requiring cost trade-off.
